verdict.rationale: Granola ships a public REST API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question, but its own API FAQ says there is no sandbox ("Not currently"). It suggests testing with a dedicated test folder, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. The interactive API playground sends live requests to the production endpoint rather than to an isolated environment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
